---
title: "Scrape: minimum wage"
engine: knitr
---

The "List of countries by minimum wage" table has a nested header: the annual and hourly figures are each split into nominal and PPP sub-columns. `pandas` reads this as a `MultiIndex`, so we flatten it into single column names before saving.

```{python}
#| label: scrape-minimum-wage
#| eval: false
import io
import pandas as pd
import requests

wage_html = requests.get(
    "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_countries_by_minimum_wage",
    headers={"User-Agent": "wikimill-project/0.1"}
).text
tables = pd.read_html(io.StringIO(wage_html), match="Minimum wage")
wage = tables[0]
wage.columns = ["_".join(c for c in col if "Unnamed" not in c).strip("_")
                for col in wage.columns.to_flat_index()]
wage.to_csv("data/minimum_wage.csv", index=False)
wage.head()
```

This chunk is shown for reference only (`eval: false`), rendering the site doesn't hit Wikipedia. Run `python src/scrape_minimum_wage.py` from the project root to refresh `data/minimum_wage.csv`. See [clean_minimum_wage.qmd](clean_minimum_wage.qmd) for the next step.
